This class is used to define a location defined by an address. It should be used only with the property dcterms:spatial, not the contact point address property.
_oldDocs.rationale: Incorporating locn:Address from the W3C Location ontology [[LOCN]] into DCAT-US provides a standardized, structured, and extensible format to represent physical addresses, facilitating consistent, interoperable, and precise sharing of location information across various datasets and digital platforms.
